detailed_descriptions_html.en:
EMERGENT STORIES

Every save plays differently. Rivalries form naturally. Media covers your gym's rise—or fall. Rival promoters poach your talent. Fighters develop grudges. One bad loss can spiral into contract disputes, injured confidence, and a gym in crisis.

DEVELOP YOUR FIGHTERS

  • Create weekly training plans with drag-and-drop scheduling

  • Balance power, speed, stamina, defense, and technique

  • Manage fatigue—push too hard and your fighter enters the ring broken

  • Track sharpness leading up to fight night

  • Handle fighter morale: they want to fight, they want to win, they want respect

RUN YOUR GYM

  • Hire trainers with different specializations and personalities

  • Scout international talent across five regions

  • Manage contracts, salaries, and sponsorship deals

  • Watch your bank account—gyms don't run on glory alone

  • Compete against rival AI gyms fighting for the same fighters and rankings

NAVIGATE THE BOXING WORLD

  • Multiple organizations from regional circuits to world championships

  • Ranking systems, mandatory defenses, and title shots

  • Accept or reject fight offers based on risk vs. reward

  • Build rivalries that drive storylines and media attention

  • Handle random events: bar fights, gym break-ins, celebrity training sessions

FIGHT NIGHT

  • Watch 3D fights unfold with realistic boxing mechanics

    • Round-by-round scoring with three independent judges

    • Knockout, TKO, split decisions, upsets—anything can happen

    • Post-fight consequences: injuries, morale shifts, ranking changes
